# Micro Mike

Micro Mike is a high-density retro dark theme aimed at mouse and eye ergonomics, with larger buttons, denser layouts, a left-aligned readable line length and consistent editor sizing. The file browser, outline, tags and backlinks are compacted with word-wrapped titles, and the theme adds colorful skeuomorphic icons and a narrow notepad mode. Appearance is adjustable through extensive Style Settings.

![Micro Mike screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thisthethe/MicroMike/HEAD/screenshotThumb.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Micro Mike"
    author: "thisthethe"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/thisthethe/MicroMike"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thisthethe/MicroMike/HEAD/screenshotThumb.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a high-density retro dark theme that optimizes mouse and eye ergonomics with larger buttons, denser layouts, left-aligned readable line length, and consistent editor sizing. Compact file browser, outline, tags and backlinks with word-wrapped titles, colorful skeuomorphic icons and a narrow \"notepad\" mode; tweak appearance via extensive Style Settings."
}
```
